name: trans-isoeugenol to arsenite
summary: A 6-step route from trans-isoeugenol to arsenite(1−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: arsenate reductase (donor)
reactions.equation: arsenite + A + H2O = arsenate + AH2 + H(+)

reactions.name: arsenate reductase (glutathione/glutaredoxin)
reactions.equation: [glutaredoxin]-dithiol + arsenate + glutathione + H(+) = glutathionyl-S-S-[glutaredoxin] + arsenite + H2O

reactions.name: malonyl-CoA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = malonyl-CoA methyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocys...
reactions.equation: malonyl-CoA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = malonyl-CoA methyl ester + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine

reactions.name: cyclopeptine synthase
reactions.equation: anthranilate + L-phenylalanine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine + 2 ATP = cyclopeptine + 2 AMP + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + 2 diphosphate + 2 H(+)
